body.text: Scenario estimate from the forecast model; it is not causal proof.

WHAT: October 2026 sales for Store type D are forecast at EUR 76.7M, +7.1% vs last month (80% range EUR 73.6M to EUR 79.9M), with an 18% chance of reaching the EUR 79.0M target.
WHY: Sustained footfall shortfall: customers 7.6% below expected last month. Biggest modeled drivers vs last month: seasonality +4.6%, monthly trend model +1.5%.
WHAT SHOULD I DO: Among the tested interventions, +5 promo days gives the strongest modeled improvement: +EUR 4.4M modeled sales; target probability 18% → 80%. This is a model-based scenario estimate, not causal proof.
